recipes.title: Lemony Orzo with Spinach & Parmesan
recipes.description: Lemon Orzo with Spinach is a bright and simple side dish you can make in no time! Packed with lemony orzo, healthy spinach, and tangy parmesan cheese, it’s so delicious.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the orzo according to the package directions. Once al dente, add the spinach to the boiling water with the orzo. Cook for 1-2 more minutes until orzo is at desired consistency and spinach is wilted.
Remove from heat and drain. Return the orzo and spinach back to the pot.
Add the olive oil, lemon juice, and parmesan cheese. Stir to combine. Season with sea salt and pepper, to taste.
Serve warm with lemon wedges (optional). Enjoy!

recipes.title: Classic Herb-Roasted Branzino
recipes.description: A traditional Mediterranean preparation of whole sea bass. The fish is stuffed with aromatic herbs and lemon, then roasted until the skin is crispy and the flesh is buttery soft.
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Pat the fish dry inside and out with paper towels. This is crucial for achieving a crispy skin.
Make three shallow diagonal cuts on both sides of the fish.
Stuff the cavity of the fish with half of the lemon slices, smashed garlic, and fresh herb sprigs.
Place the fish on the baking sheet, drizzle with olive oil, and season with salt and pepper.
Roast for 18-20 minutes until the flesh is opaque and flakes easily. Let rest for 3 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Healthy Chicken Cacciatore
recipes.description: A rustic 'hunter-style' stew made with lean chicken breast, bell peppers, and a rich tomato-herb sauce. This version is simmered slowly to meld the flavors without heavy oils.
instructions: In a large deep skillet, sear the chicken cubes in a teaspoon of olive oil over medium-high heat until golden on all sides. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, sauté the onions, peppers, and mushrooms for 5-7 minutes until softened.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes and add the oregano, salt, and pepper. Bring to a gentle simmer.
Return the chicken to the pan. Cover and simmer over low heat for 20 minutes until the chicken is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Serve over whole wheat pasta or a bed of steamed greens.

recipes.title: Tuscan Kale & White Bean Soup
recipes.description: A hearty and fiber-rich soup that defines Tuscan comfort food. Creamy cannellini beans and nutrient-dense kale are simmered in a garlic-infused broth.

ingredients.displayName: Lacinato kale, stems removed and chopped

instructions: In a large pot, sauté carrots and celery in a splash of broth or oil for 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and rosemary, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the vegetable broth and the beans. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the chopped kale and cook for another 5 minutes until the kale is tender and bright green.
Season with salt and plenty of black pepper. Serve with a drizzle of high-quality olive oil on top.

recipes.title: Zucchini Frittata with Fresh Basil
recipes.description: A light and protein-packed Italian omelet. Thinly sliced zucchini and fresh basil are baked with eggs for a simple yet sophisticated start to your day.
instructions: Whisk the eggs in a bowl with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Heat a non-stick oven-safe skillet over medium heat. Sauté the zucchini slices for 4-5 minutes until tender and slightly browned.
Pour the eggs over the zucchini. Sprinkle with the torn basil and parmesan cheese.
Cook undisturbed for 2-3 minutes until the edges are set.
Place the skillet under a broiler for 2-3 minutes until the top is puffed and golden. Slice into wedges and serve.

recipes.title: Eggplant Involtini (Ricotta Rolls)
recipes.description: Elegant rolls of grilled eggplant filled with a light herb-ricotta mixture. A healthy, low-carb alternative to traditional pasta-based dishes.

ingredients.displayName: Large eggplant, sliced long and thin

instructions: Brush eggplant slices with a little olive oil and salt. Grill or pan-sear for 2-3 minutes per side until pliable.
In a bowl, mix ricotta cheese with chopped spinach, salt, and pepper.
Place a tablespoon of the cheese mixture at one end of an eggplant slice and roll it up tightly.
Spread half the marinara in a baking dish. Arrange the rolls seam-side down in the dish.
Top with remaining sauce and bake at 375°F for 15 minutes until bubbly and hot.

recipes.title: Healthy Italian Minestrone
recipes.description: The definitive garden-fresh Italian soup. This version is packed with seasonal vegetables and beans, using whole wheat pasta for a high-fiber, low-fat meal.
instructions: In a large pot, sauté carrots, celery, and onions for 5 minutes.
Add the diced potatoes and zucchini, and cook for another 3 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable broth and diced tomatoes. Bring to a boil.
Add the whole wheat pasta and kidney beans. Simmer for 10-12 minutes until the pasta is al dente and vegetables are tender.
Stir in fresh parsley and season with salt and pepper before serving.

recipes.title: Zucchini Noodles with Walnut Pesto
recipes.description: A light and vibrant low-carb dish. Spiralized zucchini strands are tossed in a homemade pesto made with fresh basil, heart-healthy walnuts, and garlic.
instructions: To make the pesto: Combine basil, walnuts, garlic, and lemon juice in a food processor. Pulse while slowly drizzling in olive oil until a thick paste forms.
Heat a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Add the zucchini noodles and a splash of water.
Sauté for 2-3 minutes just until tender but still holding their shape. Do not overcook or they will become watery.
Remove from heat and immediately toss with the fresh pesto. Serve with a few halved cherry tomatoes on top.

recipes.title: Tuna and White Bean Salad
recipes.description: A classic no-cook Italian lunch. High-protein tuna is paired with creamy cannellini beans, red onion, and a bright lemon-herb vinaigrette.

ingredients.displayName: White meat tuna in water, drained

instructions: In a medium bowl, flake the drained tuna with a fork.
Add the cannellini beans, diced red onion, and chopped parsley.
Drizzle with lemon juice and olive oil. Season generously with cracked black pepper and a pinch of salt.
Toss gently to combine. Serve over a bed of arugula or in a whole wheat wrap.

recipes.title: Caprese Skewers with Balsamic Glaze
recipes.description: A beautiful and healthy bite-sized version of the classic Caprese salad. Featuring fresh mozzarella, sweet cherry tomatoes, and aromatic basil.
instructions: On a small wooden skewer, thread a cherry tomato, a folded basil leaf, and then a mini mozzarella ball.
Repeat for all ingredients.
Arrange the skewers on a serving platter.
Just before serving, drizzle lightly with the balsamic glaze and a tiny pinch of sea salt.

recipes.title: Whole Wheat Spaghetti Marinara
recipes.description: The ultimate simple Italian meal. We use fiber-rich whole wheat pasta and a slow-simmered homemade marinara sauce with no added sugar.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the spaghetti until al dente.
While the pasta cooks, heat olive oil in a skillet and sauté the minced garlic for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the crushed tomatoes and a pinch of salt/pepper. Simmer for 15 minutes over low heat.
Toss the cooked pasta directly into the sauce. Stir in the fresh basil leaves until wilted.
Serve immediately with a light dusting of parmesan if desired.

recipes.title: Lemon Herb Roasted Chicken
recipes.description: Juicy roasted chicken breast seasoned with Italian herbs and citrus. A high-protein staple that is both simple and extremely flavorful.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Place chicken breasts in a baking dish. Drizzle with lemon juice and a teaspoon of olive oil.
Sprinkle all herbs and seasonings over both sides of the chicken.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until the internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing to keep it juicy.

recipes.title: Bean and Spinach Salad
recipes.description: A nutrient-packed salad that provides a perfect balance of fiber and plant-based protein. Topped with a zesty lemon-vinaigrette.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the spinach, white beans, and red onion.
Whisk together lemon juice, a teaspoon of olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Toss the salad with the dressing until well coated. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Low-Carb Vegetable Lasagna
recipes.description: A clever and healthy twist on lasagna. We replace the pasta sheets with thin slabs of roasted zucchini for a low-carb, vegetable-dense meal.

ingredients.displayName: Large zucchini, sliced into long slabs

instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Roast zucchini slabs for 10 minutes to remove excess moisture.
Spread a layer of sauce in a baking dish. Top with a layer of zucchini slabs.
Spread ricotta over zucchini, then another layer of sauce and cheese.
Repeat layers twice more. Bake for 30 minutes until the top is golden and bubbly.

recipes.title: Turkey Italian Wedding Soup
recipes.description: A lighter version of the classic 'Minestra Maritata'. Featuring mini turkey meatballs and fresh spinach in a clear, nourishing broth.
instructions: Bring chicken broth to a simmer in a large pot.
Add the pre-cooked mini turkey meatballs and cooked pasta.
Simmer for 10 minutes to heat through.
Stir in the baby spinach and cook for 2 minutes until just wilted. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Grilled Swordfish with Caper Garnish
recipes.description: A Sicilian specialty. Meaty swordfish steaks are grilled quickly to keep them moist and topped with a salty-sour caper and lemon topping.
instructions: Season swordfish steaks with salt and pepper. Grill for 4-5 minutes per side until just opaque.
In a small bowl, mix capers, parsley, and a teaspoon of olive oil.
Top the hot fish with the caper mixture and a squeeze of fresh lemon.

recipes.title: Arugula and Pear Salad with Walnuts
recipes.description: A sophisticated Italian salad that hits all the flavor notes: peppery arugula, sweet ripe pear, and crunchy walnuts.
instructions: Place arugula in a large bowl. Top with the sliced pears and walnuts.
Drizzle with a simple dressing of balsamic vinegar and olive oil.
Top with shaved parmesan cheese and toss gently.

recipes.title: Mussels in Spicy Tomato Broth
recipes.description: A lighter take on 'Cozze al Pomodoro'. Fresh mussels are steamed in a fragrant broth of tomatoes, garlic, and a hint of red chili.
instructions: In a large pot, sauté garlic and red pepper flakes for 1 minute.
Add the diced tomatoes and bring to a simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the mussels and cover the pot tightly. Steam for 5-7 minutes until all mussels have opened.
Discard any that did not open. Serve in deep bowls with the broth.

recipes.title: Garlic Sautéed Broccoli Rabe
recipes.description: An authentic Italian bitter-green side dish. Blanched quickly to reduce bitterness and then seared with sliced garlic and olive oil.
instructions: Blanch the broccoli rabe in boiling water for 2 minutes. Drain and plunge into ice water.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil and sauté garlic until just golden.
Add the broccoli rabe and a pinch of salt. Sauté for 5 minutes until tender-crisp.

recipes.title: Creamy Polenta with Wild Mushrooms
recipes.description: A comforting northern Italian dish. Soft, golden cornmeal polenta topped with a mixture of earthy, pan-seared mushrooms.
instructions: Cook polenta in 4 cups of water/broth until thick and creamy (approx 20 mins).
Sauté mushrooms with thyme and garlic in a separate pan until browned.
Spoon the hot polenta into bowls and top with the mushroom mixture.

recipes.title: Baked Cod with Cherry Tomatoes & Olives
recipes.description: A light and healthy Mediterranean fish dish. Cod fillets are baked with sweet cherry tomatoes, salty kalamata olives, and aromatic herbs.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Place fish in a baking dish.
Scatter tomatoes, olives, and capers around the fish. Drizzle with olive oil.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until the fish is opaque and flaky.

recipes.title: Roasted Vegetable and Farro Salad
recipes.description: A chewy, fiber-packed grain salad featuring Farro (emmer wheat). Tossed with roasted seasonal vegetables and a balsamic vinaigrette.
instructions: Cook farro according to package directions. Drain and cool.
Roast squash and onions at 400°F for 20 minutes.
Combine farro and vegetables in a large bowl. Dress with balsamic and serve.

recipes.title: Wheat Margherita Flatbread
recipes.description: A light and healthy pizza alternative using whole wheat dough, fresh tomatoes, and part-skim mozzarella cheese.
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Place flatbreads on a baking sheet.
Layer with tomato slices and mozzarella. Bake for 8-10 minutes until cheese is melted.
Top with fresh basil leaves and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Shrimp Scampi over Zucchini Noodles
recipes.description: A low-carb version of the garlicky seafood classic. We replace traditional pasta with fresh zucchini strands to keep it light and refreshing.
instructions: Sauté garlic and shrimp in a teaspoon of olive oil for 3 minutes until pink.
Add zucchini noodles and cook for 2 more minutes just until warmed through.
Squeeze fresh lemon over the top and serve hot.

recipes.title: Healthy Panzanella Salad
recipes.description: A Tuscan bread salad that uses toasted whole wheat cubes to soak up the juices of ripe tomatoes and fresh vinaigrette.
instructions: Combine bread cubes, tomatoes, and cucumbers in a large bowl.
Let the salad sit for 10 minutes so the bread can absorb the tomato juices.
Toss with olive oil and vinegar before serving.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken Piccata
recipes.description: A bright and tangy chicken dish. We bake the chicken instead of pan-frying to reduce fat, using a zesty lemon-caper sauce for maximum flavor.
instructions: Place pounded chicken in a baking dish. Drizzle with lemon juice and scatter capers on top.
Bake at 400°F for 18-20 minutes.
Serve with a side of steamed asparagus.

recipes.title: Tuscan Ribollita (Reboiled Soup)
recipes.description: A classic Tuscan bean and vegetable soup. Traditionally thickened with bread, this version is hearty, satisfying, and full of fiber.
instructions: Simmer kale and beans in a large pot of vegetable broth for 30 minutes.
Stir in the bread cubes and cook for 10 more minutes until they break down and thicken the soup.
Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Grilled Calamari with Lemon & Parsley
recipes.description: A healthy alternative to fried calamari. Fresh squid is grilled quickly over high heat and finished with a bright citrus herb dressing.
instructions: Grill squid over very high heat for only 2 minutes per side.
Toss with fresh lemon juice and chopped parsley while still hot.

recipes.title: Cannellini Bean and Rosemary Dip
recipes.description: A smooth and savory white bean spread. Perfect as a healthy substitute for high-fat party dips or as a sandwich spread.
instructions: Blend beans, rosemary, and garlic in a food processor until smooth.
Season with salt and a touch of olive oil.

recipes.title: Roasted Fennel Bulbs with Orange
recipes.description: An aromatic side dish. Fennel bulbs are roasted until caramelized and sweet, then paired with fresh orange for a bright Sicilian-style finish.
instructions: Toss fennel slices with a little olive oil and roast at 400°F for 20-25 minutes.
Add fresh orange segments before serving.

recipes.title: Healthy Cioppino (Italian Seafood Stew)
recipes.description: A lighter take on the San Francisco-Italian classic. This tomato-based stew is brimming with fresh white fish, shrimp, and mussels.
instructions: Sauté diced fennel and onion in a large pot for 5 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes and bring to a simmer. Add the fish cubes and cook for 10 minutes.
Add the shrimp and mussels. Cover and simmer for 5-8 minutes until mussels open and fish is cooked through.

recipes.title: Vegetarian Lentil Bolognese
recipes.description: A high-protein, meatless version of the classic Bolognese sauce. Lentils provide the same hearty texture and are simmered with root vegetables.
instructions: In a large pot, sauté carrots and onions. Add the lentils and tomato puree.
Simmer for 35-40 minutes over low heat until lentils are soft.
Serve over whole wheat pasta or zucchini noodles.

recipes.title: Radicchio and Orange Salad
recipes.description: A refreshing salad from southern Italy. The bitterness of radicchio is perfectly balanced by the sweetness of fresh oranges and honey.
instructions: Combine radicchio and orange slices in a bowl.
Dress with a simple mixture of olive oil, lemon juice, and a drop of honey.

recipes.title: Baked Turkey Saltimbocca
recipes.description: A healthier take on the classic Roman dish. We use lean turkey cutlets wrapped with fresh sage and a small piece of prosciutto.
instructions: Place a sage leaf on each turkey cutlet, then wrap with half a slice of prosciutto.
Secure with a toothpick. Bake at 400°F for 12-15 minutes until turkey is cooked through.

recipes.title: Roman-Style Stuffed Tomatoes
recipes.description: Large ripe tomatoes stuffed with an herb-infused rice mixture and baked until the skins are tender and the rice is flavorful.
instructions: Hollow out the tomatoes. Mix the rice with the tomato pulp and chopped basil.
Stuff the mixture back into the tomatoes. Bake at 375°F for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Spinach Stracciatella (Egg Drop) Soup
recipes.description: The quintessential Italian 'remedy' soup. A simple broth with clouds of egg and cheese, and plenty of fresh spinach for a nutrient boost.
instructions: Bring broth to a gentle boil. In a small bowl, whisk the eggs with a teaspoon of parmesan.
Stir the boiling broth in a circular motion and slowly drizzle the egg into the pot.
Stir in the spinach and turn off the heat once it wilts.

recipes.title: Cod in Acquapazza (Crazy Water)
recipes.description: A traditional Neapolitan method of poaching fish in 'crazy water' made of cherry tomatoes, garlic, and fresh herbs.
instructions: Place tomatoes and garlic in a shallow skillet with 1/2 cup of water. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the fish fillets. Cover and poach for 8-10 minutes until the fish is opaque.

recipes.title: Escarole and Bean Soup
recipes.description: A rustic and healthy soup from the Italian countryside. This recipe uses hearty escarole greens and white beans in a savory garlic broth.
instructions: Sauté garlic in a pot. Add the beans and escarole. Pour in broth.
Simmer for 15-20 minutes until the greens are very soft.

recipes.title: Healthy Truffle Mushroom Risotto
recipes.description: An indulgent flavor with a healthy profile. We use whole grain Arborio rice and plenty of wild mushrooms to create a rich texture without heavy cream.
instructions: Cook the rice slowly by adding warm broth 1/2 cup at a time, stirring constantly.
Stir in sautéed mushrooms and finish with a drop of truffle oil.

recipes.title: Lite Caponata Siciliana
recipes.description: A sweet and sour Sicilian vegetable relish. Traditionally oily, this version is sautéed with minimal oil and emphasizes the flavors of fresh eggplant and vinegar.
instructions: Sauté eggplant and celery in a non-stick pan until soft.
Add vinegar, capers, and a teaspoon of honey. Simmer for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Alfredo Pasta
recipes.description: A creamy pasta dish with a secret. The 'Alfredo' sauce is made from blended steamed cauliflower, making it remarkably low in fat and calories.
instructions: Blend steamed cauliflower with garlic and a splash of milk until smooth.
Toss the creamy sauce with cooked whole wheat pasta.

recipes.title: Lemony Peas with Lean Ham
recipes.description: A bright and simple side dish. Sweet green peas are quickly sautéed with lean prosciutto or ham and finished with fresh lemon zest.
instructions: Sauté the ham until golden. Add the peas and a tablespoon of water.
Simmer for 3 minutes and finish with fresh lemon zest.

recipes.title: Roasted Asparagus with Parmesan
recipes.description: The perfect spring vegetable side. Asparagus spears are roasted until tender and topped with a light dusting of sharp parmesan cheese.
instructions: Roast asparagus at 400°F for 10-12 minutes.
Sprinkle with parmesan cheese while still hot.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Squash Aglio e Olio
recipes.description: A classic Italian pasta preparation using spaghetti squash as a low-calorie noodle alternative. Packed with garlic, olive oil, and parsley.
instructions: Roast the squash until the strands can be pulled out with a fork.
Toss the 'noodles' with sautéed garlic and plenty of fresh parsley.

recipes.title: Italian Herb Roasted Salmon
recipes.description: Juicy salmon fillets seasoned with a blend of classic Italian dried herbs and baked to flaky perfection.
instructions: Season fish with herbs and bake at 400°F for 12-15 minutes.

recipes.title: White Bean & Tomato Crostini
recipes.description: A fiber-rich appetizer featuring a creamy white bean mash and fresh diced tomatoes on whole wheat toast points.
instructions: Top toasted bread slices with white bean spread and fresh diced tomatoes.

recipes.title: Lemony Orzo with Baby Spinach
recipes.description: A bright and simple side dish. We use fresh baby spinach and plenty of lemon to create a vibrant, healthy accompaniment to any meal.
instructions: Mix cooked hot orzo with fresh spinach until wilted. Season with lemon juice.

recipes.title: Healthy Baked Eggplant Parmesan
recipes.description: A lighter take on the Italian classic. Eggplant slices are baked instead of fried, layered with low-sugar sauce and a controlled amount of cheese.
instructions: Bake eggplant slices until soft. Layer with sauce and cheese, then bake for another 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Classic Tuscan Kale Salad
recipes.description: A raw salad that highlights the power of kale. Massaged with lemon and oil to tenderize the leaves and finished with sharp cheese.
instructions: Massage kale with lemon juice and oil until soft. Top with shaved parmesan.

recipes.title: Baked Pears with Ricotta & Honey
recipes.description: A light and healthy Italian dessert. Ripe pears are baked until tender and served with a dollop of creamy ricotta and a drizzle of honey.
instructions: Bake halved pears at 375°F until soft. Top with a spoonful of ricotta and honey.
